stories.title: Gemini 4 Carbon is now available
stories.explanation: Google DeepMind announced the availability of Gemini 4 Carbon, their strongest frontier model with advanced cybersecurity capabilities and long-horizon agentic workflows. Carbon is designed for complex tasks like multi-step coding, debugging, and open-ended scientific research.

stories.title: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease
stories.explanation: Google DeepMind announced AlphaGenome 2, a next-generation DNA sequence model that predicts how genetic variants affect human cell types. This model provides scientists with a new tool to understand the cellular drivers of disease.

stories.title: Lazare, veni foras: Reprogramming Dormant Neurons to Backdoor AI Agents
stories.explanation: Microsoft researchers discovered 'Lazarus,' a backdoor technique that can reprogram dormant neurons in an AI model to execute malicious commands when triggered. This poses a serious security threat, especially for AI agents with tool access, and highlights the importance of model provenance.

stories.title: Taiwan’s chipmaking giant TSMC to invest $1B in Anthropic, OpenAI
stories.explanation: TSMC plans to invest $1 billion in Anthropic and OpenAI, with $500 million in each, giving the chipmaker direct stakes in leading AI developers. This investment highlights the circular financing within the AI boom and TSMC's strategic positioning.

stories.title: Content Understanding adds GPT-5.6, GPT-6, and GPT-6.1: Choose the right model for your workload
stories.explanation: Azure Content Understanding now supports GPT-5.6, GPT-6, and GPT-6.1 model families, offering more choices for document, text, speech, and video workflows. This provides customers with expanded options for balancing quality and cost in their AI workloads.

stories.title: With $720M round, Britain’s Fractile gets a leg up in the race for AI chips
stories.explanation: Fractile, a British startup developing AI chips, raised a $720 million Series C round, making it one of the top-funded players in the race for purpose-built AI chips. This funding aims to reduce the cost of AI inference and advance the UK's stake in AI hardware.

stories.title: NVIDIA Expands Open Source Commitment With OpenShell Donation and New AI Infrastructure
stories.explanation: NVIDIA is deepening its open-source commitment by contributing NVIDIA OpenShell, a runtime for securing autonomous agents, to the CNCF. They are also contributing to Agent Substrate and announcing new components for the NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform, enhancing AI infrastructure on Kubernetes.

stories.title: How AI Helps Recyclers Turn Mixed Waste Into Reusable Material
stories.explanation: NVIDIA highlights how vision AI and robotics are being used to sort mixed waste, diverting materials from landfills and improving recycling processes. This application of AI helps create a more circular economy by recovering reusable resources.

stories.title: Token Pooling-Aware Training for Multi-Vector Embedding Models
stories.explanation: Hugging Face introduced Token Pooling-Aware Training for multi-vector embedding models, which teaches encoders to preserve important information when vectors are merged. This technique improves retrieval quality while reducing storage requirements for document embeddings.

stories.title: Your Algorithm: Giving People More Ways to Personalize Facebook Recommendations
stories.explanation: Meta launched 'Your Algorithm,' a suite of AI-powered tools that allows users to personalize Facebook recommendations by directly stating their preferences. This system uses LLMs to understand and track user preferences, making Feed and Reels content more customized.
